author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/05_Practical Steps for Laboratory Safety Hierarchy of Controls Training Course/src.py

points.K2: 控制层级：越往上越有效

points.K7: 管理控制：改变做事方式
points.K8: 个体防护是最后一道防线
points.K9: 靠防护挡住了，说明前面失守
points.K11: 从未遂事件中修订分析
points.S1: 动手之前，先做风险评估
points.S2: 用好通风柜等工程设施
points.S3: 管理措施在实验室怎么落地

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个五层倒三角图旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large inverted triangle diagram divided into five colored layers with no text.
shots.narration: 这一课讲控制层级。
overlay: 控制层级：从源头管住危害

shots.scene: 倒三角五层依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: An inverted triangle with five blank colored layers lighting up one by one from top to bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 消除、替代、工程、管理、个体防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上护目镜和手套，满意地拍拍胸口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles and gloves and pats his chest confidently.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：护目镜手套都戴了，够安全了。

shots.scene: 台面上杂物乱堆，试剂瓶摇摇欲坠
shots.prompt_en: A cluttered bench with reagent bottles stacked precariously near the edge and cables across the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 可他的台面乱糟糟，瓶子快掉下来了。

shots.scene: 小研指着台面摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the cluttered bench and shakes her head at the young male student.
shots.narration: 小研说：防护只是最后一道关。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜看实验台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at a lab bench through a big magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 实验室里，很多事都可能出错。

shots.scene: 放大镜下浮现火焰、玻璃碎片、滴液图标
shots.prompt_en: Under a magnifying glass, icons appear: a small flame, broken glass and a dripping liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 先认出危害，想到会出什么错，

shots.scene: 一面盾牌罩住几个小人
shots.prompt_en: A large shield icon covering a small group of person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 再尽一切可能保护自己和别人。

shots.section_title: 控制层级：越往上越有效
shots.scene: 倒三角图，顶部宽、底部窄，箭头从上往下
shots.prompt_en: An inverted triangle with five blank layers, a big arrow beside it pointing from the wide top down to the narrow bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 控制层级从上到下，效果越来越弱。
overlay: 控制层级：越往上越有效

shots.section_title: 控制层级：越往上越有效
shots.scene: 欣欣指着三角形最宽的顶部
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the wide top layer of the inverted triangle.
shots.narration: 能往上层想办法，就别只靠下层。

shots.scene: 三角最底层亮起护目镜、手套、实验服图标
shots.prompt_en: The narrow bottom layer of the inverted triangle lights up with icons of goggles, gloves and a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 护目镜、手套、实验服，在最底层。

shots.scene: 阿杰惊讶地张大嘴
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks surprised with his mouth open, holding his goggles.
shots.narration: 阿杰吃惊：它们居然效果最差？

shots.scene: 三角顶层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The top layer of the inverted triangle lights up in bright green. No people.
shots.narration: 从最上面看：能不能让危害消失？

shots.scene: 小研把杂物收进柜子，地上的电线理好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts clutter away into cabinets and tidies cables off the floor.
shots.narration: 把东西收好，就不会掉落、绊倒人。

shots.scene: 整洁的台面上打了一个大勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean, tidy lab bench with a big green check mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 危害没了，这显然是最好的办法。

shots.scene: 第二层亮起，腐蚀性瓶子换成肥皂
shots.prompt_en: The second layer of the triangle lights up; a bottle with a corrosion pictogram is swapped for a plain soap bottle along an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 不能消除，就换成更安全的。

shots.scene: 小研用肥皂水清洗器皿
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes glassware with mild soapy water at a sink, wearing gloves.
shots.narration: 比如用肥皂水，代替腐蚀性清洗剂。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 第三层亮起，人和危害之间出现一道透明挡板
shots.prompt_en: The third layer lights up; a clear barrier appears between a person pictogram and a hazard icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还不行，就用设施把人和危害隔开。
overlay: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 小研双手伸进手套箱的手套孔操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with her hands inside the built-in gloves of a sealed glove box.
shots.narration: 比如手套箱，人在外面，危害在里面。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 通风柜视窗后，气流箭头向上排走
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with its sash lowered, arrows showing air drawn away upward behind the glass. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜、防护罩，都是工程控制。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：改变做事方式
shots.scene: 第四层亮起，日程表和流程图图标
shots.prompt_en: The fourth layer lights up with icons of a calendar and a simple flowchart. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制，改变的是做事的方式。
overlay: 管理控制：改变做事方式

shots.section_title: 管理控制：改变做事方式
shots.scene: 时钟、次数、刻度三个图标都在变小
shots.prompt_en: Three icons shrinking: a clock, a tally counter and a level gauge, each with a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 少接触、短接触、低浓度接触。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：改变做事方式
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一份空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank procedure document seriously.
shots.narration: 排在下面，也一样不能马虎。

shots.section_title: 个体防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 最底层亮起，一面小盾牌挡在人前
shots.prompt_en: The bottom layer lights up; a small shield stands right in front of a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 个体防护，是最后一道防线。
overlay: 个体防护是最后一道防线

shots.section_title: 靠防护挡住了，说明前面失守
shots.scene: 前面四道墙都有缺口，只剩最后一道盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Four walls with gaps in them, and only the last small shield blocking a flying droplet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 真靠它挡住了，说明前面都失守了。
overlay: 靠防护挡住了，说明前面失守

shots.section_title: 靠防护挡住了，说明前面失守
shots.scene: 空白事故报告单
shots.prompt_en: A blank incident report form with a pen and a yellow warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这可能已经是要上报的事故了。

shots.scene: 小研对照清单挑选手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student chooses gloves and goggles from a shelf while checking a blank list.
shots.narration: 防护用品选得对、穿得好，

shots.scene: 护目镜挡住飞溅的液滴图标
shots.prompt_en: Close view of safety goggles blocking a splash of droplets, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 关键时刻，才能真正保住你。

shots.section_title: 动手之前，先做风险评估
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank risk assessment form with a checklist.
shots.narration: 选哪层措施，先要做风险评估。
overlay: 动手之前，先做风险评估

shots.section_title: 动手之前，先做风险评估
shots.scene: 小研和老周一起填写评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man fill in a blank risk assessment form together at a desk.
shots.narration: 列出危害，估计风险，定好措施。

shots.section_title: 动手之前，先做风险评估
shots.scene: 评估表上导师签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs the blank form; a green check appears beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 新实验、改流程，都要重新评估。

shots.section_title: 用好通风柜等工程设施
shots.scene: 通风柜视窗拉到合适高度
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the fume hood sash to a safe working height before starting.
shots.narration: 工程设施要会用：视窗拉到位。
overlay: 用好通风柜等工程设施

shots.section_title: 用好通风柜等工程设施
shots.scene: 通风柜里堆满瓶子挡住风口，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood crammed with bottles blocking the rear baffle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里不堆杂物，不挡住风口。

shots.section_title: 用好通风柜等工程设施
shots.scene: 拆下的防护罩被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A removed instrument safety guard lying on a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防护罩、联锁装置，不能随意拆。

shots.section_title: 管理措施在实验室怎么落地
shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰讲解空白操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank standard operating procedure to the young male student.
shots.narration: 管理措施，先从操作规程和培训做起。
overlay: 管理措施在实验室怎么落地

shots.section_title: 管理措施在实验室怎么落地
shots.scene: 深夜独自做实验的人影，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A single person silhouette working alone in a dark lab at night, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险实验不单独做，有人陪同。

shots.section_title: 管理措施在实验室怎么落地
shots.scene: 门口的警示标志和限量图标
shots.prompt_en: A lab door with a yellow warning sign and a small bottle icon showing a reduced amount. No people.
shots.narration: 限时限量，挂好警示标识。

shots.section_title: 从未遂事件中修订分析
shots.scene: 试剂瓶差点从台边掉下被接住的示意图
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle tipping off a bench edge and being caught just in time, with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 差点出事的未遂事件，也是一次提醒。
overlay: 从未遂事件中修订分析

shots.section_title: 从未遂事件中修订分析
shots.scene: 小研在空白风险分析表上修改
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student revises a blank hazard analysis sheet with a pen.
shots.narration: 用它来修订作业危害分析。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告刚才的险情
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports a near miss to the older man in the lab office.
shots.narration: 未遂事件，要报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 空白登记本和一个握手图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank near miss logbook beside a handshake icon. No people.
shots.narration: 报告不是挨批，是帮大家避开下次。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手向小研提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask the female graduate student a question.
shots.narration: 不懂危害分析怎么做，就问导师。

shots.scene: 实验室成员围成一圈讨论
shots.prompt_en: Lab members including the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student stand in a circle discussing.
shots.narration: 一次失误，一个人，大家一起学。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现倒三角
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating inverted triangle with five blank layers.
shots.narration: 先消除，再替代，然后工程和管理。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标在三角底部
shots.prompt_en: A small shield icon glowing at the bottom tip of the inverted triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 个体防护是最后一道防线，要选对穿好。

shots.scene: 评估表、通风柜、报告单三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blank risk assessment form, a fume hood and a blank report form. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估，用好设施，未遂也报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁台面前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 从源头管住危害，下次见！
